name: Halve
storyline:
Long ago, the world thrived under the protection of two sacred spirits: the Deer, guardian of land and fertility, and the Bird, guardian of the wind and sky. They eventually united as one goddess, bringing harmony and life to the world. But an envious god, resentful of the devotion she received, tried to destroy her. Instead, it split her into two fragile halves, leaving the world in ruin.

Awakening in the devastated remains of civilization, the two halves begin a journey of survival and self-discovery. As they explore forgotten shrines and sacred ruins, they uncover the truth of their shared past and realize they may be able to become whole again. Hunted by the jealous god, they must reach the temple built in their honor, reclaim their lost power, restore balance, and reunite before they are destroyed.
summary: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.
